fix_plan.name: level2_source_fix_priorities_current_state
fix_plan.goal: Harden Level 2 native correctness, remove interpretation traps, and align the patch queue with the code as it exists now.
fix_plan.status_note: This queue reflects the current repository state after native backend integration, metric cleanup, documented grid convention, native diagnostics, and upgraded front lifecycle tracking.

priority_scale.P0: must fix before trusting new scientific interpretation
priority_scale.P1: should fix before next serious sweep

already_addressed_or_partially_addressed.title: Grid convention clarity
notes: Grid convention is now documented in pde_solver.py and docs/level2_protocol.md.
Remaining work, if any, is consistency cleanup in native comments rather than a missing design decision.

already_addressed_or_partially_addressed.title: Front tracking existence
notes: Cross-time front matching and velocity estimation already exist in diagnostics.py.
Lifecycle metadata has also been added: created, continued, merged, split.
Remaining work is stronger scientific semantics, not adding front tracking from scratch.

already_addressed_or_partially_addressed.title: Negative undershoot naming cleanup
notes: negative_undershoot_events now exists as the clearer public field.
The legacy alias nonnegativity_violations is still exposed intentionally for compatibility.
A later breaking cleanup can remove or deprecate the alias.

items.title: Validate state vector sizes against grid.Nx
items.location_hint: At start of run(), before any stepping or band construction
items.problem: epsilon, rho, and residue are copied from initial_state but not checked against Nx.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Undefined behavior, corrupted dynamics, misleading results, possible crashes.

required_change.failure_behavior: throw std::runtime_error with explicit size report

acceptance_criteria: Run aborts immediately on malformed initial state
Error message reports expected Nx and actual sizes for all arrays

items.title: Make invalid-value detection symmetric
items.location_hint: invalid-value detection path in the native solver
items.problem: Current logic detects non-finite values and large positive magnitudes, but not large negative magnitudes.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Numerical blow-up can masquerade as physical extinction after clamping.
acceptance_criteria: Large negative excursions trigger invalid-state handling
No negative blow-up survives into post-clamp interpretation

items.title: Redesign exclusion metric near rho≈0 and low-activity states
items.location_hint: node_ratio, exclusion_fraction, front detection, and any logic that assumes epsilon/(rho+delta) is always meaningful
items.problem: epsilon/(rho+1e-9) becomes arbitrarily large when rho collapses, even if both fields are effectively inactive.
items.risk_if_unfixed: False exclusion takeover, inflated sharpness, misleading front width, and distorted classification.

recommended_options.name: masked_ratio
recommended_options.definition: node_ratio = epsilon / max(rho, rho_floor), but classify only where epsilon + rho > activity_floor

required_change.undefined_low_activity_behavior: mark node as inactive or undefined and exclude it from exclusion classification

acceptance_criteria: Low-activity regions no longer auto-count as exclusion-dominated
A run with rho collapse but vanishing epsilon does not report false full exclusion
Classification thresholds are revalidated against the revised metric

items.title: Track and report low-activity mask explicitly
items.problem: Current metrics still conflate meaningful phase competition with dead or nearly empty nodes.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Interpretation of fronts and domain fractions remains ambiguous even after metric redesign.
acceptance_criteria: Summary outputs distinguish active exclusion from extinction or inactive regions

items.title: Strengthen front tracking semantics for scientific interpretation
items.problem: Front tracking exists, but lifecycle semantics remain incomplete for review-grade interpretation.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Merge/split behavior and disappearance events remain harder to analyze rigorously.

current_state: front IDs persist across saved frames
front velocities are estimated across time
observed lifecycle fields already include created, continued, merged, split
next_steps: decide whether terminated states should be represented explicitly
tighten merge/split matching semantics if needed
use lifecycle metadata in classification or summary logic

acceptance_criteria: Traveling and pinned fronts remain easy to identify
Split and merge behavior is represented consistently in outputs

items.title: Finalize undershoot metric contract
items.problem: negative_undershoot_events is clearer than the old name, but its behavior is still a per-step event count rather than a true count of negative entries.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Reviewers may still over-interpret the number.

options: Implement a true count or richer summary such as count/min/sum_negative_magnitudes
required_change.compatibility_note: nonnegativity_violations is currently a compatibility alias and should only be removed with an explicit deprecation plan

items.title: Harden empty-input handling in metrics
items.problem: Several metric paths assume non-empty arrays and can divide by zero or access front/back on malformed input.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Rare crashes or undefined metric behavior on degenerate input.

required_change.action: Return safe defaults or throw explicit error on empty arrays

acceptance_criteria: No divide-by-zero or front/back access on empty inputs

items.title: Expose metric thresholds as named parameters
items.problem: Thresholds like rho floors, activity floors, and exclusion thresholds are hidden constants.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Results remain harder to calibrate, reproduce, and defend.
acceptance_criteria: Thresholds appear in config or run metadata
Default values are explicit and documented

items.title: Document native-side grid convention inline
items.problem: The overall grid convention is documented, but the native-side code still relies on implied meaning.
items.risk_if_unfixed: Future native-only contributors may misread the spatial contract.

required_change.action: Mirror the documented half-open grid convention in native comments near GridConfig and coordinate generation

acceptance_criteria: Native code comments match the documented Python-side convention

items.title: Make Python wrapper more robust to config object types
items.risk_if_unfixed: Wrapper can fail when passed dict-like or model objects.

required_change.action: Accept dataclasses, dicts, or objects with model_dump()/dict()

acceptance_criteria: Wrapper works across common config container types

tests.name: malformed_state_size_test
tests.purpose: Confirm early abort on size mismatch

tests.name: negative_blowup_injection_test
tests.purpose: Confirm symmetric invalid detection catches large negative values

tests.name: dead_domain_metric_test
tests.purpose: Set epsilon≈0 and rho≈0 everywhere; ensure exclusion-like metrics do not falsely report dominance

tests.name: rho_collapse_without_epsilon_dominance_test
tests.purpose: Verify metric distinguishes extinction from exclusion dominance

tests.name: traveling_front_sanity_case
tests.purpose: Check that front velocity and width behave sensibly in a controlled moving-front setup

tests.name: steady_interface_case
tests.purpose: Check near-zero velocity for a stationary interface

tests.name: split_merge_tracking_case
tests.purpose: Check lifecycle metadata remains consistent for front branching behavior

decision_rule.before_P0_complete: Do not trust exclusion-dominance interpretation in low-activity regimes and do not trust malformed-input robustness.
decision_rule.after_P0_complete_before_revalidation: Treat new results as provisional until metric redesign revalidation is complete.
decision_rule.after_P0_revalidation: Allowed to rerun targeted scans with revised metric semantics.
decision_rule.after_P1_complete: Allowed to make stronger propagation and domain-interpretation claims.
